Remark
[higher-dimensional hyperbolic space as a Lie group, contrasted with spheres]

Source: petersen:page-0161 ↗ prop:pet-ch4-hyperbolic-lie-group-not-biinvariant subsection 4.2 generalizes: the upper half-space is in a natural way a Lie group with a left-invariant metric of constant curvature $-1$ in every dimension. This is in sharp contrast to the spheres, where only $S^3=SU(2)$ and $S^1=SO(2)$ are Lie groups.
